LanguageData.CC_Settings_InspectPortrait: A large portrait at the inspect pane
LanguageData.CC_Settings_InspectPortrait_Tip: With one person selected on the map (a colonist, a slave, a prisoner, a visitor, a raider), a large portrait of them stands above the inspect pane at the bottom left, with their name and the name the colony knows them by. With a tab open (Bio, Gear, Health) it stands beside the tab. Drag its top right corner to make it larger or smaller; click it for their card. Needs the deeper game hooks.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_InspectPortrait: The selected person's face, large, above the inspect pane.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_InspectPortraitSize_Tip: How wide and tall the portrait at the inspect pane is, from 96 to 360. Dragging its top right corner sets this too. Where the screen has less room, it is drawn smaller.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_InspectPortraitSize: Its width and height on the screen; dragging its corner sets it too.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_PortraitHeadgear_Tip: On, every portrait Rimfolk draws (letters, event cards, the colonist card, the lists and the large portrait) shows the helmet or hat a person wears, as the game draws them. Off, the face and hair without it, so a person looks the same whatever they wear on their head.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_PortraitHeadgear: Portraits show helmets and hats as worn; off, a face stays the same whatever they wear.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_PortraitClothes_Tip: On, portraits show the clothes and armour on the body as worn. Off, the body without them, so new armour changes nothing in the picture.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_PortraitClothes: Portraits show the clothes and armour they wear.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_PortraitPoses_Tip: A person's portrait shows how they hold themselves: the chin up for the proud (a proud trait, a council seat, the head of a people, a title), the head a little down for the sad or grieving, a lean for the angry (a break, a fresh quarrel), turned half away for the shy, a slight stoop for the old, the head low for a prisoner, and the dead drawn grey. A pose stays for at least an hour of the game unless a break, death or captivity changes it. The large portraits and those in letters and cards take a pose; the small ones in lists face the front. Two people side by side in a letter or a tie face each other either way.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_PortraitPoses: Portraits show the proud, the sad, the angry, the shy, the old, prisoners and the dead each their own way.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_PortraitsMove_Tip: The large portrait at the inspect pane and the one on the colonist card breathe, sway a little and now and then turn to one side and back. They hold still while the game is paused. The small portraits in lists never move.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_PortraitsMove: The large portraits breathe, sway and now and then turn to one side; still while paused.
LanguageData.CC_Portrait_GripTip: Drag to make the portrait larger or smaller.
